€1P. (अति), अतति, अतितुम्, अत्त-अतित 
__1 To go, walk; wander, to go constantly. 
__2 To obtain (mostly Ved.) 
__3 To bind. 
__4 (अन्तति) To bind.

The letter आ. ind. Ved. 
__1 Afterwards, then; generally used antithetically to यद्, यदा, यदि and then sometimes strengthened by the particles अह, उ, इद् &c. 
__2 Then, further, also, and (अपि च). 
__3 Some-times it only strengthens the meaning of another word or gives emphasis to an interrogative pronoun like उ, अङ्ग, नु added to किम् (possibly, at all).
